summary.text: Matthew Kordon is the Libertarian candidate for North Carolina House of Representatives District 11 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against incumbent Democrat Allison Dahle.
He says in a Ballotpedia survey that he founded a game development company in 2018 and works at Dell Technologies in Apex.

paragraphs.text: Kordon was born in Baltimore, Maryland, and earned a bachelor's degree from the University of North Carolina at Wilmington in 2019, according to Ballotpedia.
In a Ballotpedia survey he said he grew up in North Raleigh, graduated from Wakefield High School, earned a degree in computer science with a concentration in business, and now lives in Cary.
He said he has been a libertarian since 2013 and worked blue-collar jobs before founding his company.
Ballotpedia lists his profession as computer programmer.
Kordon ran for the same seat as a Libertarian in 2024, receiving 1,416 votes, or 2.9 percent, in a race won by Dahle.

He said he supports ranked-choice voting, wider civil liberties including adult alcohol and marijuana use and carrying firearms in public, shifting some power from state government to local communities, and reducing taxes and spending while supporting public, charter, religious, micro and home schooling.
